text: 你把西尔维娅扶起。她双眼空洞，仿佛视线穿过了你。诺曼着手扎营，试图营造熟悉的环境。她在睡袋里躺了几个小时后，似乎终于恢复过来。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 245
text: You pick Sylvia up off the ground. Her eyes stare through you, vacant. Norman sets up camp, attempting to create a familiar environment. After a few hours in her bedroll, Sylvia seems to come out of it.
